Forgot to set a timer? No worries, it’s already running. 

Safera Sense recognizes various cooking events on the stove and creates a visual timeline on the app. For example, from the timeline, you can easily see how long your pasta has been boiling. If you wish, you can set up timers starting from past cooking events to alert you when your food is ready.

The more you interact with Safera Sense, the smarter it gets. You can save your successful cookings. AIR QUALITY
Do you know your home air quality? We’ll tell you when it’s time to ventilate.

Cooking decreases your home air quality. People often ventilate their home too late in the cooking process. Safera Sense monitors air quality and notifies you when it is time to ventilate. With the Safera App, you also learn how your cooking affects air quality. The app shows you carbon dioxide levels, humidity and tVOC (Total Volatile Organic Compounds).

COOKING SAFETY
Is your attention needed elsewhere? That’s ok, we’ll cover you.

Cooking is the #1 cause of home fires. People forget to turn off the cooker or leave it unattended for too long. Safera Sense will sound an alarm and notify the user with the app if the stove is left on or danger occurs.

If you have upgraded Safera Sense to control your cooker (with an optional Power Control Unit, available at www.safera.com), then Safera Sense also cuts off the cooker power automatically, even if you are not at home or able to take action.

Safera App is connected via Bluetooth to one or many Safera Sense units (many units can be connected to one app simultaneously). It tells if you have installed your Safera Sense correctly and the sensors are getting the best possible readings from your stove.

SAFERA CLOUD
Using Safera App, you may link your Safera Sense units to Safera Cloud. This enables remote alerts via SMS and/or E-mail, and data collection with visualization of your cooking statistics and air quality. It also enabled collaboration and event sharing between other 3rd party Cloud services.

FIRMWARE UPDATES
Whenever there is a new software update, Safera Sense is updated over-the-air with the Safera App.
